tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the Cadencz workspaces (businesses or brands) the person can use. Only needed when they have more than one; every other tool defaults to the current workspace.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List the social media accounts connected to Cadencz (X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky and others). Use before scheduling or publishing, or when asked which accounts are connected.

tools.name: list_brains
tools.description: List the Brains in this workspace. A Brain is what Cadencz learned about a business from its website: product, audience, positioning and voice. Usually there is one.

tools.name: query_brain
tools.description: Answer questions about the person's own business from what Cadencz knows about it — its product, audience, positioning, competitors and brand voice, learned from their website. Use this whenever they ask what Cadencz knows about their business, product or customers, and before writing posts. Default

tools.name: get_current_plan
tools.description: Show this week's social media content plan in Cadencz: each planned post with its theme, platform, day and status. Use after plan_week, or when asked what is planned this week.

tools.name: get_plan_usage
tools.description: Show how much of the workspace's allowance is used this period (posts written, AI generations, scheduled posts) and what is left.

tools.name: list_scheduled_posts
tools.description: List posts scheduled to go out on social media in the coming days (default 7), with platform and time. Use when asked what is scheduled, queued or going out soon.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Report how the person's published social posts performed — likes, replies, reposts and other engagement per platform over the last N days (default 30).

tools.name: compose_post
tools.description: Write one social media post for a platform (LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky…) from an idea, grounded in the Brain — what Cadencz knows about the business — and in the person's own voice (the workspace's Brain, unless brain_id names another). The post is saved as a draft in Cadencz; nothing is publishe

tools.name: plan_week
tools.description: Plan this week's social media posts: Cadencz writes a batch of drafts across the connected platforms from the Brain and the week's goal, for the person to review in Plan my week. Nothing is published. Each planned post draws from the shared AI-generation allowance.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule a draft post (variant_id from compose_post or the plan) to publish at a given time. Confirm the time with the person first.

tools.name: publish_now
tools.description: Publish a draft post to its social network right now. Public and irreversible: ask the person to confirm first, then call with confirm: true.

tools.name: cancel_scheduled_post
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled post so it does not go out; it goes back to being a draft.

tools.name: approve_plan_item
tools.description: Approve a post from this week's plan, which schedules it for its planned time.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_channels, get_current_plan, get_plan_usage, list_scheduled_posts, get_analytics · Public sink: get_current_plan, compose_post, plan_week, schedule_post, publish_now, cancel_scheduled_post, approve_plan_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_channels, get_current_plan, get_plan_usage, list_scheduled_posts, get_analytics · Public sink: get_current_plan, compose_post, plan_week, schedule_post, publish_now, cancel_scheduled_post, approve_plan_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
